text: The street sits within that established residential fabric, and its position near the historic core places it among the older housing stock in Milton rather than the newer subdivision builds to the south and west.
Shortreed Crescent is a residential curve in Milton's Coates neighbourhood, a pocket of the town that sits east of the escarpment and north of the Derry Road corridor.
Baverstock Crescent is a residential crescent in Milton's Clarke neighbourhood, a pocket of the town that has filled in steadily as Milton has grown westward and northward along the escarpment side.
